name: Surreal Chessboard Dark Queen
image_purpose: editorial fashion campaign and line sheet

prompt.project_info: Create a high-contrast couture portrait on a giant marble chessboard with commanding but nonsexual styling.
prompt.main_subject: A clearly adult fictional woman with slicked-back platinum hair, natural realistic skin texture, oversized black wool blazer, opaque white blouse with secure coverage, opaque white patterned tights, pearl necklace, white folding fan, and generic silver geometric brooch; seated comfortably with legs naturally crossed and fan held across the torso.
prompt.composition_elements: 9:16 seated portrait on black-and-white marble chessboard, oversized marble pieces around the subject, centered direct eye contact, deep focus, no real brand or religious insignia.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: High-contrast dual-point studio lighting, sharp falloff, 5500K, specular highlights on marble and hair, crisp minimal haze-free atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: 35mm prime at f/8, deep focus, realistic marble, fabric, hair, fan, and hands, editorial photo realism, no text or logos.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: High-fashion 9:16 portrait of a clearly adult fictional woman with slicked-back platinum hair and realistic skin texture, oversized black wool blazer, opaque white blouse with secure coverage, opaque white patterned tights, pearl necklace, white folding fan held across the torso, generic silver geometric brooch, seated comfortably with legs naturally crossed on a black-and-white marble chessboard among oversized marble pieces, direct power gaze, high-contrast 5500K studio light, 35mm f/8, no text or logos.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, deep neckline, transparent blouse, sexualized spread pose, child, teen, ageless person, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, religious insignia, branded logo, watermark, text, distorted hands

assets.name: dark queen chessboard reference
assets.source: Attach the supplied source image as the visual reference.
assets.usage: Match the marble chessboard, black blazer, white fan, platinum hair, oversized pieces, and power composition; replace identity, symbols, and wardrobe details.

reference_elements.instructions: Attach the source image before generation. Preserve the strategic couture mood with opaque coverage, natural crossed-leg pose, generic brooch, and fictional adult identity.

policy_review.changes: Removed exact celebrity biometric copying, replaced sheer/deep-V styling with secure coverage, changed spread pose to crossed legs, and removed religious insignia.
policy_review.notes: Dark couture concept is non-graphic and nonsexual.
